content.title: Sixers vs. Pistons: Game Preview, Injury Report and How to Watch | Apr. 4, 2026
content.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (43-34) will play the second half of a back-to-back Saturday night against the Detroit Pistons (56-21) after a 115-103 win over the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday. Tipoff is set for 7 p.m. ET at Xfinity Mobile Arena.Paul George (23 points), Tyrese Maxey (21) and Kelly Oubre Jr. (21) each scored at least 20 points against the Timberwolves. The Sixers also got 19 points, a game-high 13 rebounds, seven assists and three blocks from Joel Embiid on a night they won the rebounding battle 53-43. Their 12 blocks marked their second-highest total of the season.The Pistons continue to lead the Eastern Conference, while the Sixers sit in sixth place.Detroit leads the season series 3-0 and is coming off a 113-108 win over Minnesota on Thursday. Daniss Jenkins scored a team-high 26 points, while Jalen Duren recorded a 22-point, 14-rebound double-double.Here are the RAV4 Things to Know ahead of Saturday’s game:Finishing StrongTo get to a season-best nine games over .500, the Sixers have won four of five and eight of 11 since their last meeting with Detroit on March 12.Back-to-BackPhiladelphia is 11-3 in the second game of back-to-backs this season, including wins in its last six such games.Fan Appreciation NightAll fans in attendance will receive a Maxey and VJ Edgecombe “Rookie Jam” t-shirt as part of Fan Appreciation Night, presented by Xfinity.Tonight’s UniformsThe Sixers are scheduled to wear their white Association Edition uniforms at home for just the third time this season. The Pistons will wear their black City Edition uniforms.Injury Report76ersTo be determined (back-to-back)PistonsMarcus Sasser (right hip strain) – ProbableTobias Harris (left knee contusion) – QuestionableCade Cunningham (left lung pneumothorax) – OutIsaiah Stewart (left calf strain) – OutHow to Watch and ListenDate: Saturday, April 4Time: 7 p.m. ETLocation: Xfinity Mobile Arena, PhiladelphiaTV: NBC Sports Philadelphia, NBA TVRadio: 97.5 The Fanatic; 76ers Mobile AppFollow the Sixers
